_comment: Predeclared execution parameters for gate G0.c. The amendment binds to this
file; the evaluator consumes it. Declaration and enforcement land together so
they cannot drift apart across commits.
Every value here is a free parameter that would otherwise be chosen at
execution time. The prior adjudication found that L -- the quantity deciding
Condition 7 -- depended on an undeclared seed. This closes that.

population.seeding_method: vint_train.data.vint_dataset.navfm_seed_sampling, called immediately before dataloader iteration in every arm
population.rationale: goal sampling uses a navfm-controlled RandomState isolated from the global numpy stream (patch sampling_rng_isolation), so the population is a function of this seed alone and is identical across all arms
population.verification: every arm compares its realised pairs, in draw order, against the pinned manifest digest at runtime

checkpoint_arm.repeat_criterion: exact equality of parsed numerical and lineage records, not bit-identical serialized output

control_arm.note: three distinct initialisations on ONE population; the evaluation seed is deliberately identical to the checkpoint arm's

loader.worker_seeding: not applicable at num_workers=0; declared because PyTorch reseeds torch and random per worker but not numpy, which would reintroduce population variance
loader.ordering: torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed) passed to the DataLoader; ordering is a function of the declared seed alone
loader.drop_last_rationale: upstream keeps the short trailing batch and it counts equally in the unweighted per-batch mean (F6)

environment.basis: navfm.provenance effective-import fingerprint: python, torch, cuda, distribution digest, os, arch, PYTHONPATH, prefixes, PYTHONHOME, user-site enablement, and normalised locations of the seven load-bearing modules
environment.enforcement: the freeze audit recomputes this at gate time and FAILS on mismatch, listing the differing fields

upstream.enforcement: the freeze audit verifies commit, patch content digest and application status at gate time, so an unpatched clone or an upstream change cannot silently alter the sampling semantics this amendment freezes
